The arena and zoo quarter once served as a recreation area to the Yalahari. Now, all animals run free, their enclosures are destroyed and former gladiators stray around the area mazily to find opponents.

The arena quarter can be found at the west gate of the city.

Upper Levels
A - Entrance area 2 Bugs, Terror Bird Massive Earth Elemental, Giant Spider, Wyrm
B - Around Alchemist Quarter gate 2 Lions, 2 Hyaenas, 2 Scorpions, 2 Cobras, 2 Bears, 4 Spider, Bug
C - Northwestern area 2 Tigers, 4 Wolves Ancient Scarab, Scarab
D - Western area Toad, Centipede Behemoth
E - Southwestern area Troll Champion, 6 Trolls, Bear, Snake, 2 Crocodiles, Squirrel
F - Southern area 2 Kongras, 2 Centipedes, 2 Snakes, Panda, Carrion Worm, Butterfly (Blue), Butterfly (Red) Quara Constrictor Scout
G - Around Foreigner Quarter gate Tortoise, 2 Cave Rats, Rat, 2 Hyaenas, 3 Centipedes, Wolf, Snake
H - Eastern area 2 Hyaenas, 2 Crabs, Elephant, Carniphila Dragon Lord, Hydra
Arena - ground floor Gladiators, Mutated Rats
